messages:
Carla M.: Heads-up — found a dead internal link in the Private deployment guide (runtime/private-deploy.md). It points to /dedicated/ instead of /dedicated-capacity/ when linking the reserved capacity section. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.s3/err/priv-deploy-link.png
link-checker-bot: Auto-scan detected 1 404 in sources/content/runtime/private-deploy.md -> /dedicated/ (line ~122). Severity: medium.
Dylan: nice catch. Is this just a bad relative path or did something move in the nav?
Carla M.: Looks like a copy-paste from an older guide. Quick fix is to update the markdown link to /dedicated-capacity/. Also frontmatter on that page has no doc owner, so we should add one.
Ben: I can handle the PR today. Quick sed I ran locally: `sed -i 's|/dedicated/|/dedicated-capacity/|g' content/runtime/private-deploy.md` — will include frontmatter owner: `owner: @ben`.
Alice: Will that affect localized variants (ja/ and fr/)? The scanner only saw the en file.
Ben: Good call — I'll grep for any other occurrences: `rg "/dedicated/" -g '!node_modules' -n content | sed -n '1,200p'` and patch matches. If there are localized files I'll add identical fixes and leave a note for translators.
Carla M.: please add a short changelog entry in the PR template so docs-sre knows why we changed the nav link. Also assign to @alice for i18n signoff if localized files are touched.
Ben: PR opened: https://git.redwood.dev/r/redwood/docs/pulls/4321 — small change, updated link and added `owner: "Ben"` to frontmatter. Added changelog snippet under docs/CHANGELOG.md. Marked for i18n review if needed. :thumbsup:
Alice: Reviewing now. If we touch ja/fr I'll coordinate a backport.
link-checker-bot: Re-scan queued for PR #4321. Expected results: 0 remaining 404s from that pattern.
Dylan: quick question — do we prefer owner to be github handle or display name in frontmatter? I see both formats in other files.
Carla M.: prefer handle (`@ben`) in the owner field for consistency with the docs ownership scan. Thanks Ben for the fast patch.
Ben: Updating frontmatter to `owner: "@ben"` in the PR now. Ping if anything else.
Alice: LGTM for en. If link-checker-bot clears localized files, I'll approve the PR and request a backport for ja/fr.
Carla M.: Great — thanks everyone. One follow-up: can we add a tiny CI check to fail builds when a docs link resolves 404 during PR? Filing a separate ticket, but pinging eng-infra as a follow-up.
Dylan: +1 on the CI check, this pattern keeps coming up.
link-checker-bot: PR scan complete: 0 failures for pattern `/dedicated/`. Status: ready for review.
Ben: Merged after Alice approved the i18n note. Closing thread. :rocket:
